answer: Stop sybils with a sparrow glacier signal: an agent bonds a glacier plot. Each cycle it releases a sparrow at the ice wall; verifiers match the signal echo to the plot chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed echo, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 takes 1,000 plots at 17x: one sparrow calls at one wall, its echo set by that shape, unrepeatable for a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents release once, keep rights.
